description: The file defines the HomeActivity class for an Android TV application, managing the main home screen UI with top menu, content rails, and navigation.

classes.name: HomeActivity
classes.description: Main activity for the TV home screen, handling UI setup and navigation.

methods.name: onCreate
methods.description: Initializes the activity, sets layout, and sets up UI components like top menu and rails.

methods.name: setupTopMenu
methods.description: Configures the top menu with focus behavior and click navigation to LoginActivity and MainActivity.

methods.name: openContentInfo
methods.description: Starts ContentInfoActivity with extras based on selected content.

methods.name: setupRails
methods.description: Dynamically creates content rails with focus and click interactions, including subscription row.
